task: Retrospective conditional harvest seed-dry-matter regression for recorded cereal-legume systems
claim_policy: Only supported claims may appear as findings; conditional claims require their qualifier; blocked claims must not appear as conclusions.

claims.claim: The prepared benchmark contains 607 crop-management systems in eight geographic groups, evaluated with grouped outer holdouts and five declared seeds.
claims.qualifier: Seeds measure computational variability and are not independent regional trials.

claims.claim: In the original frozen eight-method outer study, XGBoost had the lowest observed equal-group RMSE (1.2461 t/ha) and pooled RMSE (1.7335 t/ha).
claims.qualifier: Descriptive within this benchmark; no inferential superiority or field-generalization claim.

claims.claim: A training-only zero-support guard substantially reduced neural errors in a fixed-model sensitivity analysis.
claims.qualifier: Designed after outer-test failures were exposed; post-hoc sensitivity, not independent confirmation or a replacement for original results.

claims.claim: The prospectively frozen fixed-public unnoised refit achieved equal-group RMSE 1.067407 +/- 0.021053 t/ha and pooled RMSE 1.201189 +/- 0.038476 across five seeds.
claims.qualifier: Descriptive seed SD, not a geographic confidence interval; four groups had negative mean outer R2.

claims.claim: In the matched aggregation-noise simulation, equal-group RMSE increased from 1.067407 for the cached reference/clipped control to 1.182853, 2.218085 and 5.628243 at noise multipliers 2, 4 and 8.
claims.qualifier: Utility simulation only; no application differential-privacy certification, secure aggregation, or private release claim.

claims.claim: The fixed inner search does not establish universal convergence: 80/224 candidates reached the 240-round boundary and 11/56 selected checkpoints were worse than their matched training constant.
claims.qualifier: Preserve as a limitation; budgets were not extended after outer-score exposure.

claims.claim: The system recommends the best crop or improves yield, profit, resource use, or farmer outcomes.
claims.qualifier: No valid counterfactual ranking labels, economic utility, or prospective field trial.

claims.claim: The method is knowledge-guided or validates agronomic rules.
claims.qualifier: No independent compatible unit/scope-validated rules are eligible for this regression study.

claims.claim: The implementation provides formal end-to-end privacy or secure aggregation.
claims.qualifier: Application accounting, private preprocessing/release policy, established SecAgg deployment, and threat-model closure are incomplete.

claims.claim: The work establishes a novel knowledge-guided federated crop-recommendation method or numerical superiority to published papers.
claims.qualifier: The active task is conditional regression; closest-paper review is not exhaustive and external protocols are not comparable.
